t: You're looking at Touchstone, a sculpture in the form of a big stone, set in the Oval Triangle. It's by Peter Randall-Page, a British artist and sculptor born in 1954, known for his stone sculpture. His work is inspired by geometric patterns found in nature. In his own words, geometry is the theme on which nature plays its infinite variations, a kind of pattern book from which nature builds its most complex structures. Look at the surface of the stone and see what patterns you can find.
